ShawnMoghadam## Shawn Moghadam
### Tenure
2023–2024
**Shawn Moghadam**(read "mog-hah-dam") is an industrial designer who worked at Mattel from 2023 to 2024. Prior to working at Mattel he worked at Tesla as a visual artist. He also teaches part-time at the Gnomon School of Visual Effects.
